address: 8 Hart Avenue, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Named after the Thai word for friends, this bustling joint with an open kitchen, colourful façade and Thai pop soundtrack oozes tropical vibrancy. The menu covers all-time Thai favourites, from street snacks and boat noodles to rice dishes and desserts. The pad kra pao – minced pork or beef with holy basil and fried eggs on steamed rice – has a wonderful kick. Try the kha nom krok, too: crispy coconut rice flour pancakes with custardy centres....
